abstract: The structural change process in Sub-Saharan Africa involves a shift of labour out of agriculture and into the nonagricultural sector, with the traditional service sector absorbing the bulk of labour leaving agriculture. Several hypotheses concerning this process will be examined using data from eighteen Sub-Saharan countries from 1990 to 2018. The results indicate that agricultural productivity increases are associated with the shift of labour into the nonagricultural sector. This shift is positively associated with development measured broadly, with the most important relationship being the expansion of the traditional service sector employment share. The employment expansion in this sector is mainly driven by increases in agricultural productivity. Finally, as traditional service sector employment increases, productivity in this sector increases. Policy implications include increased investment to raise agricultural productivity as well as programmes aimed at supporting productivity growth in traditional services. The results are important because the data seem to indicate that the traditional process of structural change (agriculture to manufacturing) does not seem to be relevant for much of Sub-Saharan Africa.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的结构变迁过程涉及劳动力从农业向非农业部门的转移，其中传统服务业部门吸纳了大部分离开农业的劳动力。本文将利用1990年至2018年间十八个撒哈拉以南国家的数据，检验关于这一过程的若干假设。结果表明，农业生产力提升与劳动力向非农业部门的转移相关联。这种转移与广义上的发展呈正相关，其中最重要的关联在于传统服务业部门就业份额的扩大。该部门就业的增长主要由农业生产力提升所驱动。最后，随着传统服务业就业的增加，该部门的生产力也随之提高。政策含义包括增加投资以提高农业生产力，以及旨在支持传统服务业生产力增长的计划。这些结果具有重要意义，因为数据似乎表明，传统的结构变迁路径（从农业到制造业）对撒哈拉以南非洲的大部分地区并不适用。

title: Sub-Saharan Africa’s development pattern
title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的发展模式

abstract: Digital technology is wider penetration, as reflected in its ability to directly or indirectly embed the improvement of productivity efficiency into other industries. Utilizing the China’s Industrial Productivity (CIP) database and industry classification, we employ the growth accounting method to measure Total Factor Productivity (TFP) for various industries and the digital economy. And we further construct the TFP input-output model, dismantling the factor input and final demand, to explore China ‘s production efficiency linkage and transmission path across digital economy and various industries. Our empirical results show that TFP input and final demand have increased after multiple transmitting by digital economy, but these TFP transmission effect is mainly within the digital economy itself, its pervasiveness effect to other industries is still weak. Moreover, from industrial perspective, high-tech-dependent industries show higher sensitivity and influence than non-technology-dependent industries when considering TFP input, and the feed-back effect to digital economy of TFP technology spillover from producer services is higher than that of advanced manufacture. This study provides new perspectives and critical empirical evidence on how TFP can penetrate and transmit to other industries through digital economy, offering significant policy implications for enhancing the spillover effects of the digital economy and optimizing industrial policy.
abstract_zh: 数字技术的渗透性日益增强，体现在其能够直接或间接地将生产效率的提升嵌入其他产业之中。借助中国工业生产率（CIP）数据库及行业分类，我们采用增长核算方法测算了各行业及数字经济的全要素生产率（TFP）。进一步地，我们构建了TFP投入产出模型，分解要素投入与最终需求，以探究中国数字经济与各行业间的生产效率联动及其传导路径。实证结果显示，经过数字经济的多次传导，TFP投入与最终需求均有所增长，但这些TFP传导效应主要局限于数字经济内部，其对其他行业的渗透效应仍显薄弱。此外，从产业视角看，高技术依赖行业在TFP投入方面展现出比非技术依赖行业更高的敏感性与影响力，而生产者服务业对数字经济的TFP技术溢出反馈效应高于先进制造业。本研究为理解TFP如何通过数字经济渗透并传导至其他行业提供了新视角与关键实证依据，对增强数字经济溢出效应及优化产业政策具有重要政策启示。
